feature_contract.goal: Restore the complete shipped DX9Ex package startup path: all profile buttons select the current DLL/host, PowerShell works with spaces in the game folder, and blocking startup failures surface a persistent and visible reason.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Launch PowerShell scripts and their DX9Ex Active package verifier only; no HMD optical or world/FFB/DX11/DXVK changes.
feature_contract.special_work_evidence: User reported twice on 2026-10-13 that the packaged DX9Ex executable did not launch. Static inspection shows Start-Process -File received an unquoted script path and stale slots shadow canonical DX9Ex binaries.
trace_stages: Packaged ZIP installs current game x86 dinput8.dll and x64 helper beneath backends/d3d9.
Slot selector resolves effective source and copies the selected pair into the game folder.
GUI prepares launch through PowerShell -File then runner validates canonical executable and invokes the game and OpenXR host.
subcomponents: Unify current profile selection and GUI eligibility on the canonical DX9Ex payload despite stale old slots.
Fix spaces in PowerShell -File and propagate the exact cause of failed launch into a visible dialog and persisted text.
Run targeted destructive-mutation source test and Windows PowerShell parser with exact-SHA full game/host/package CI.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: All DX9Ex profiles use the same current game DLL and host, ignoring stale slots and avoiding silent wrong-build selection.
Space-containing game paths launch with a correctly quoted script; missing files, hash mismatch, and other failures display and persist the real failure instead of silently vanishing.
Targeted negative tests, Windows PowerShell parse, full DX9Ex Active host/game/package and Domain Isolation succeed on exact validation commit; real Quest3 remains untested.

diagnosis.original_evidence: 2026-10-13 reported packaged DX9Ex run failure without log or actual on-disk game path; static launch defect demonstrable in source.
diagnosis.root_cause: GUI assembled an unquoted powershell -File value through Start-Process ArgumentList; DX9Ex non-CURRENT_FOCUS slots could select stale old DLL and host directories.
alternatives_rejected: No evidence current game native render path is responsible for process bootstrap; avoid changing renderer, hooking, or VR projection without runtime logs.
Do not blindly change original EXE hash/accept unknown binaries to mask launch mismatches.
source_trace: DX9Ex Active package publishes backends/d3d9/dinput8.dll and outrun-vr-host.exe.
Select-OutRunVRBackend.ps1 previously favored existing slots/VARIANT directories; game DLL identity could be stale.
OutRunVR-Slot-Selector.ps1 previously started hidden powershell with unquoted -File path; Run-OutRunVRTest.ps1 had no top-level visible error channel.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: No per-eye changes; preserve original stereo composition and Quest3 untested state.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: Canonical payload selection and quoted runner from initial material, plus fresh manifest and active-marker verification and exact-SHA full Win32 host/game/package success. No HMD testing.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: Exact SHA 897c3047 DX9Ex Active policy SUCCESS, PowerShell parser and ten destructive launch-path mutations PASS.
diagnosis.ci_failure_cause: DX9Ex Active #38418040430 policy failed: negative regression checker accepted a commented-out '& $selector' invocation as active PowerShell.
diagnosis.post_failure_repair: GUI now rejects stale/mismatched session ID, backend/profile/variant and ACTIVE_VR_BACKEND identity; anchored executable-line verifier rejects commented calls and 10 negative mutations.
